message:
The other day, while waiting for a storm to blow through, I found myself rummaging through the old board games in the attic. You know, the ones that have been gathering dust for years? I dusted off a classic and set it up for a little family game night. 

It turns out that a little low-tech fun is just what we needed to distract ourselves from the howling winds outside. We laughed, argued over the rules (as always), and enjoyed each other’s company without a screen in sight. 

Sometimes, the best way to prepare for the unexpected is to rediscover the simple joys of being together. What’s your favorite way to have fun indoors when the weather gets wild? ☔
